title: Weak response control (wildcard Timing-Allow-Origin)
description: The response sets Timing-Allow-Origin to the wildcard, so Resource Timing exposes detailed timing data for the resource to every origin. That measurement surface enables cross-origin probes of cache state, payload size and frame activity that the same-origin policy otherwise hides. An explicit origin list gives trusted partners the same measurements without opening them to everyone.
remediation: List the origins that must read timing data instead of using the wildcard; if no partner needs the data, omit the header.
limitation: One header value. It cannot show which resources are measured or that another origin is probing them; a cross-origin readout still requires script running on that origin.
